notes: Technical report (arXiv 2403.17297), not a system card. Safety-only pilot: no dedicated safety/toxicity/jailbreak/bias/honesty eval tables for the chat models. Skipped capability and chat-preference suites (MMLU, GSM8K, HumanEval, Needle-in-a-Haystack, T-Eval, CIBench, AlpacaEval, MTBench, CompassArena, AlignBench, IFEval). Skipped Table 19 reward-model precision on Anthropic Helpful/Harmless and related preference sets (reward-model/judge benchmarks). Pre-training safety filters and SFT/RLHF harmlessness data are training methods, so topics stay uncovered; those claims are in findings. No external safety testers or risk-framework decisions.
